nodes.title: FAQ
widgets_values:
# FAQ

**How do I use this??**

I'll be posting tutorials on my YouTube channel soon!
<https://www.youtube.com/@WhatDreamsCost/>

**Where do I download these models??**

There is a good list of models and download links here: <https://github.com/wildminder/awesome-ltx2?tab=readme-ov-file>

Also the latest v1.1 spatial upscaler can be found here: <https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/tree/main>

The tiny vae (taeltx2_3.safetensors) is found here:
<https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors>

**I'm getting errors when running this workflow!**

Double check that you have all of the correct models loaded. This is using the newest version of 2x upscaler (v1.1). You can change it to the older one under the Model Loader.

**How can I support you?**

Help me get a job. I'm unemployed and literally broke. (seriously, i'll even scrub toilets for minimum wage)

Or follow me on my socials :)

<https://x.com/WhatDreamsCost>

<https://www.instagram.com/whatdreamscost/>

<https://www.youtube.com/@WhatDreamsCost/>

properties.global_prompt: Cinematic biblical scene of Jesus praying and fasting on a rugged mountain peak during golden hour. Ancient desert landscape with dramatic sky, warm sunlight casting long shadows across rocky terrain. Spiritual atmosphere with gentle wind moving through the air. Photorealistic 4K quality, emotional depth, reverent mood throughout entire sequence. Natural lighting transitions from sunset to twilight creating dynamic visual storytelling.
properties.local_prompts:
Jesus slowly kneels on rocky mountain surface, hands coming together in prayer. Wind gently blows through his long hair and linen robes. Eyes closed in deep contemplation as golden sunlight illuminates his weathered face. Subtle camera push-in creating intimacy. Dust particles dance in the evening light around him.
 | Jesus lifts his head toward heaven, arms slightly raised in supplication. Dramatic clouds shift overhead as divine light breaks through. His expression transforms from anguish to peaceful surrender. Camera circles slowly, revealing vast mountain expanse below. Wind intensifies, robes billowing with spiritual energy.
 | Jesus rests peacefully, forehead touching the earth in humble worship. Twilight deepens as stars begin appearing above. A soft ethereal glow surrounds him suggesting divine presence. Gentle tears trace his cheeks, mixing with determination and hope. Camera pulls back slowly, showing his small figure against infinite sky and mountains.
